title: 页签
summary: 一排标签只说了能切。先定选中态是短线、连上面板、步骤三态、轨道滑块、叠纸，还是缩略图本身。
summaryEn: A row of labels only says you can switch. First decide whether selection is a short bar, a joined panel, three-state steps, a sliding pill, stacked paper, or the thumbnail itself.
asks: 这一排标签，选中态是哪种模型？
asksEn: Which selection model is this tab row?

links.when: 页签切的是这一页里的面板，不是顶栏去哪
links.whenEn: a tab switches a panel on this page; it does not take you somewhere else
